Rerouting requires no stationed security: each one-way trip takes 120 seconds longer and additionally consumes food 6, wood 1, and tools 0.1. Shipments already en route are unaffected.

Later, you can fund the construction of a training ground, draw security personnel from registered residents, and coordinate joint defense with the other party. For now, you can reroute convoys or temporarily suspend convoy dispatches.
Each one-way trip takes 120 seconds longer and additionally consumes food 6, wood 1, and tools 0.1.

Constructing a training ground requires wood 120, steel 80, tools 30, and parts 20, and takes two construction workers 360 seconds. Once complete, residents must be assigned to training manually; security personnel will not appear automatically.

Each security person consumes food 0.5, tools 0.05, and medicine 0.01 every 10 seconds; at least 2 people must complete 300 seconds of training. Supply interruptions or insufficient personnel will cause drill progress to regress.

Escorting alone requires this community to assign 4 people: each trip consumes food 12, tools 0.4, and medicine 1. For a joint escort, each party assigns 2 people: this community provides food 6, tools 0.2, and medicine 0.5; the other party provides food 6 and tools 0.2.

The outbound escort trip must stop for 30 seconds to drive away the beasts; it pauses if there are not enough personnel. Each one-way rerouted trip takes 120 seconds longer and additionally consumes food 6, wood 1, and tools 0.1; the plan can be changed only after the convoy returns to the city.

Joint escort agreements require this community's knowledge 120 and the other party's 60; they occupy 1 coordination responsibility, while the populations and warehouses of both parties remain independent.
